name: envelope
description: An addressed paper envelope for letter beats: cream envelope with a folded flap, a haldi stamp square, an optional red postmark and an ink address block (first line = 'Bill to'-style label in pencil). Params: lines = address lines, pincode = optional last line printed big with a blue-ballpoint underline, postmark = optional red round text, x/y = top-left, width (default 860). Tossed in at a seeded tilt on the cut frame; fully drawn after it.
